items.transcript: Ometepe is one island made of two volcanoes. Concepcion and Maderas are joined by a low isthmus. The island is 31 kilometers long and 5 to 10 kilometers wide. Concepcion is active with a textbook cone. Its base is 16 kilometers across. The slopes are covered in dense green. Higher up, the mountain vanishes into cloud. Verdict and honest frame.
